title: End-to-end: two transit nodes propagate article bidirectionally
description:
Start two transit daemon instances, peer them, have node A ingest an article via IHAVE, wait up to 10 seconds, verify the article is available on node B by querying its Message-ID->CID map and its group log. Then have node B ingest a different article and verify it propagates to node A. Artifact: tests/e2e/transit_propagation.rs.

Acceptance criteria:
- Article ingested on A is retrievable on B within 10 seconds
- Article ingested on B is retrievable on A within 10 seconds
- Group log on both nodes contains both articles after propagation
- Test is deterministic (fixed peer IDs)
- Test passes with: cargo test --test transit_propagation
